messages:
maria: Alert from audit: multiple Dedicated control-plane admin ops failing in prod. KMS decrypt errors + 403 on /controlplane/admin endpoints. Noticing for a handful of customer dedicated clusters. Any quick thoughts?

audit-bot: [ALERT] 1765237889 - controlplane-admin-access-failed - https://internal.redwood/alerts/1765237889 - added to SEC-7834

samir: I think this lines up with the rbac-serviceacct-refactor that merged last night (PR #4321). We added a new role model but I suspect some clusters missed the rolebinding reconciliation.

jess: Confirmed. Customer RID-443 hit this during onboarding. They couldn't list controlplane routes. Marking P0 until we restore access.

kevin: Pulling audit logs now. Seeing a DELETE on RoleBinding "priv_admin-binding" for svcacct:controlplane-admin@dedicated in cluster-ded-3 at 2026-03-10T02:14:08Z. Looks like the migration script removed it because it didn't detect the legacy label.

maria: Oof. Can you grep the cluster?

samir: running cluster check: `kubectl --context=cluster-ded-3 -n redwood get rolebinding controlplane-admin-binding -o yaml` -> NotFound.

jess: We should reapply the binding manually to unblock. Also the KMS errors — are they from the same svcacct lacking kms:Decrypt permission?

kevin: Yeah. The controlplane-admin SA used to have a bound IAM role that allowed kms:Decrypt for the dedicated KMS key. When the rolebinding was removed, token exchange failed -> KMS decrypt -> endpoints returned 403.

samir: I'll reapply the RoleBinding now and then roll the rbac-migration back on cluster-ded-3.

samir: Applying quick patch: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: controlplane-admin-binding
  namespace: redwood
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: controlplane-admin
  namespace: redwood
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: priv_admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

```

deploy-bot: rollback of deploy rbac-serviceacct-refactor v2.1 initiated by samir at 1765237972 

audit-bot: Event logged: SEC-7834 - rebind_applied (id: e3f2a7)

jess: After rebind, can someone hit the admin endpoints and confirm KMS decrypts succeed?

kevin: Running test script against cluster-ded-3: `scripts/check_controlplane_admin.sh cluster-ded-3` -> KMS unwrap succeeded, tokens minted, admin endpoints returning 200.

maria: Good. Please leave the rollback in place until we fix the migration script + add a preflight.

samir: Agree. I see the root cause: the migration expects label `rbac.migrated=true` but some older clusters used `rbac_migrated=true`. I'll push a fix and a safety check that refuses to delete bindings if a manual marker is missing.

jess: Also add a post-change smoke test to the pipeline that verifies service-account access and KMS decrypt on a sample cluster.

kevin: Note for compliance: because KMS failures occurred, we should rotate the service-account key material and update the KMS key policy to explicitly allow the controlplane-admin role in dedicated projects. I'll open a PR for the KMS policy and schedule a short key rotation window.

maria: Can someone open the Jira and assign follow-ups? I want: 1) migration script fix (samir) 2) preflight + smoke in CI (jess) 3) KMS policy + rotation (kevin) 4) runbook update + postmortem (maria).

samir: Created SEC-7834-1 (migration script fix) and linked to SEC-7834. PR incoming: #4390. Adding preflight checks to refuse dangerous deletions.

jess: I'll add the smoke test to the pipeline and a gating check to fail the PR if smoke doesn't pass on a staging cluster. PR #4392.

kevin: PR #4391 opened for KMS key policy change. Planning rotation at 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC (30m). Will notify customers per compliance.

maria: Audit request: keep logs for 90 days for this incident window and export KMS logs to the compliance bucket. audit-bot, can you create that export?

audit-bot: Export task created (export-id: exp-20260310-01) -> logs retained and copied to gs://redwood-compliance/SEC-7834/

jess: Smoke tests passed in prod after rebind. Confirmed with customer RID-443 — they have admin access again.

samir: Migration fix merged and applied to rows of clusters; added a non-destructive dry-run flag. Will coordinate a maintenance window to re-run migration safely.

kevin: KMS policy PR merged. Rotation completed successfully. Verified decrypts post-rotation.

maria: Thanks. Follow-ups: schedule a 30-min blameless review tomorrow 15:30 PT, update the RBAC runbook with the new preflight checks, and add a postmortem doc to SEC-7834. I'll draft the incident note now.

samir: Marking SEC-7834 P0, removing rollback after confirming all clusters patched.

audit-bot: Incident SEC-7834 archived to ticket SEC-7834; timeline and artifacts attached.

maria: Closing thread for now. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
